price_why: For a freelancer billing a gym client, this gives a ready-to-build post for this week and four more after it, all tied to the gym's reset cycle and to first-timers' fears. That saves real planning time and gives them sourced reasoning to show the client. It is still one week's plan rather than a reusable system, so $49 is a stretch.
one_line: A research-backed content brief for a bouldering gym's Instagram. It leads with a fully specified 'new set as a guidebook topo' carousel and adds four adapted post concepts borrowed from other niches.
strongest: The lead topo carousel is ready to produce. It has a settled cover treatment (low-contrast wall photo with numbered dashed lines), slide-by-slide content, a fill-in hook and a named way it could fail, and it serves both members and the gym's reset rhythm.
weakest: The taste section is empty and section 5 is thin. Several posts also depend on the setters' cooperation (handwriting, photos before stripping, a quote), which the creator has to arrange with people they don't control.
